$comment: PRIVATE Vidak-owned ontology schema (Channel). schemaId is a stable Vidak catalogue identifier — not a MetaState-issued W3ID and not a canonical public W3DS schema.
title: Channel
description: PRIVATE Vidak-owned draft-07 Channel schema for platform-local W3DS-compatible use. Owned by the creator eName (creator eVault).

id.description: MetaEnvelope object id within the owner eVault (local W3ID / UUID). Distinct from Vidak's product-local channel id.

ownerEName.description: Creator eName. Mapping Rules ownerEnamePath resolves ownership to this eVault.

handle.description: Public handle unique within the platform projection; interoperable as a string field.

avatarFileUri.description: Optional avatar as a w3ds://file URI.

bannerFileUri.description: Optional banner as a w3ds://file URI.

visibility.description: Optional channel discovery intent when synchronized.
